page_title: SAS 2-3 LEC | Sassuolo v Lecce 17/05/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+9' Christian Frangella (Sassuolo) is caught offside!
90+6' 2 - 3 Goal - 2:3! Omri Gandelman laid the ball off to Nikola Stulic (Lecce), who shot from close range into the bottom right corner, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
90+6' What a big chance! Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and skies the ball well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lecce.

90+4' Excellent touch by Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo)! He latches on to an inch-perfect pass deep into the box and unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper reacts superbly and makes a save.
90+2' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
90+2' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Lecce.
90+1' Federico La Penna shows a yellow card to Antonino Gallo (Lecce) for a tough tackle.
90+1' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' Lecce will take a corner kick.
89' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
88' Substitution. Christian Frangella (Sassuolo) has come on for Armand Lauriente.
85' Eusebio Di Francesco has decided to substitute Danilo Veiga and he is replaced by Konan Ndri (Lecce).
85' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Ylber Ramadani as he is replaced by Nikola Stulic (Lecce).
85' Tiago Gabriel (Lecce) receives a yellow card for infringement.
82' 2 - 2 GOAL! Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) finishes off a sublime move with a delightful back-heel goal. Ulisses Garcia provided the assist with a brilliant pass. 2:2.
82' OFF THE BAR! Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) unleashes a thunderous effort from the edge of the box and the ball crashes off the woodwork. What a strike that was!
81' Danilo Veiga (Lecce) sees a yellow card from Federico La Penna after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
80' Eusebio Di Francesco has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Francesco Camarda (Lecce) replacing Walid Cheddira.
79' Today's match ends for Santiago Pierotti who will be replaced by Omri Gandelman (Lecce).
77' Federico La Penna shows a yellow card to Tarik Muharemovic (Sassuolo), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
76' Darryl Bakola (Sassuolo) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while in possession of the ball.
74' Dangerous play by Darryl Bakola (Sassuolo). Federico La Penna blows his whistle for a foul.
72' Fabio Grosso has decided to make a change. Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo) replaces Domenico Berardi.
72' It will be a substitution. Darryl Bakola (Sassuolo) is ready to enter the pitch as Ismael Kone walks off.
71' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
70' Sassuolo seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
67' Federico La Penna couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Walid Cheddira (Lecce) and blew his whistle.
63' Lameck Banda is being substituted because of an injury. Eusebio Di Francesco sends Gaby Jean (Lecce) on the pitch.
63' Substitution. Nemanja Matic did his best and is replaced by Luca Lipani (Sassuolo).
63' Fabio Grosso prepares a substitution. M'Bala Nzola is replaced by Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo).
59' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.

57' Lameck Banda (Lecce) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike to the bottom left corner. Stefano Turati pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill.
56' M'Bala Nzola (Sassuolo) leans back and sends a volley soaring over the bar from inside the box. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.
54' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Federico La Penna ignores the protests.
53' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) takes a short free kick.
51' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
50' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
49' Ulisses Garcia (Sassuolo) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
47' Wladimiro Falcone (Lecce) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The referee signals a corner kick to Sassuolo.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+2' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
45+1' Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
43' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) takes the resulting free kick, but no praise for this shot as it blazes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.
42' Federico La Penna blows for a foul after Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
40' Woyo Coulibaly (Sassuolo) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
37' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) sends a weak shot high over the bar from the edge of the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sassuolo.
36' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.

35' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball goes out of play and Lecce have been awarded a corner kick.
33' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) swings the ball into the box from the corner kick but it's a bit too strong and it goes out of play.

32' Walid Cheddira (Lecce) gets on the end of a cross inside the box and sweeps the ball goalwards towards the left side of the goal, but Stefano Turati is well positioned and easily deals with the effort. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Lecce.
32' Lecce take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
30' The linesman raises his flag. Walid Cheddira (Lecce) is adjudged offside.
30' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Sassuolo due to an offside in the build-up play.
29' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Sassuolo players aren’t happy.
28' Fantastic team goal! Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) was set free in the area by Domenico Berardi and fired low past Wladimiro Falcone. 2:2.

25' 1 - 2 The ball hits the back of the net! Lameck Banda showcases his brilliant technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box, where Walid Cheddira (Lecce) manages to convert it into a sweet goal. He heads it inside the right post and gets on the scoresheet – 1:2.
24' The resulting corner from Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) is cleared by the opposition's defence.

23' A neat pass is well received by Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper makes an incredible save to block his shot. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Sassuolo.

20' 1 - 1 It's a goal! Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) shows off his superb ability as he volleys the ball from inside the box low into the middle of the target. The assist goes to Pedro Felipe and the score changes to 1:1.
19' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Lecce.
17' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
14' 0 - 1 Goal! Some very poor defending from the opponent allows Walid Cheddira (Lecce) the chance to get to the edge of the box and he makes no mistake with a lovely finish. It's 0:1.

13' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the bottom right corner, but Wladimiro Falcone thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
12' Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
10' Ismael Kone (Sassuolo) fires a shot high over the bar from inside the box after latching onto a short pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lecce.
7' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Walid Cheddira (Lecce) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.

7' Oumar Ngom (Lecce) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
6' Woyo Coulibaly (Sassuolo) jumps into a tackle and Federico La Penna signals a foul.
3' Oumar Ngom (Lecce) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
2' Walid Cheddira (Lecce) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players. Lecce have been awarded a corner kick.
2' Sassuolo take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
1' Ismael Kone (Sassuolo) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot which is wide of the mark. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Lecce will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Federico La Penna.
